text:
marta: quick scrumbump — mid-cycle pulse on console observability. ask: short statuses for dashboards, trace hooks, error-analysis views, and retention gating. any blockers? @kevin @sandeep

kevin: dashboards — session & latency panels are wired, frontend bits in place. blocked on metrics schema change in observability-api (PR linked). ETA Tue for merge unless reviews stall. no UI perf issues.

sandeep: trace hooks — instrumentation PR landed for agent-service, but we still need onboarding docs + a feature-flag rollout plan. also want to confirm sampling rates (currently 1% default). pinging @olivia for runbook.

olivia: docs/runbook — I can draft a short playbook tonight. quick q: retention default for GA = 90d or 60d? product had 90d preference but cost team flagged storage.

jun: error-analysis view — prototype gives grouped error traces + top stack frames, basic noise filter working. need sample queries to validate across services; will add business-tag filter to UI.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy to staging started for obs-hooks v2 (rev abc123). monitor: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/obs-hooks/v2/5678

marta: thanks. action items summary: (1) kevin: get metrics-schema PR merged by Tue EOD, (2) sandeep: FF rollout checklist + sampling recommendation, (3) olivia: draft runbook + retention recommendation by EOD Wed, (4) jun: PR with sample queries by tomorrow. I'll collate and open a short infra quota ticket if retention stays at 90d. :thumbsup:

kevin: ack. PR: https://github.com/redwood/observability-api/pull/412 — needs schema owner (+1) and a quick migration plan note.

sandeep: FF checklist sketch (will paste here soon): - feature flag in config - canary 5% - sampling metrics exported - health/watchdog alert - rollback playbook + telemetry to detect regressions.

jun: sample query I'll use for noise filtering tests:
```
SELECT error_type, count(*)
FROM traces
WHERE service = 'agent' AND timestamp > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY error_type
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

olivia: retention take — recommend default 60d for self-serve to control costs, offer 90d as enterprise opt-in with pricing notes. I'll add pros/cons in runbook.

marta: perfect. final asks: anyone can review kevin's schema PR today? @sandeep offered after 3pm PT. If no other blockers we'll target merging Tue and a small staging canary Wed.

sandeep: I can review today after 3pm PT.

kevin: thanks all, I'll queue reviews and add migration notes.

marta: closing loop — I'll update the roadmap milestone "obs-console midcycle" to reflect these owners and ping infra for quota if needed. will post a short status update in #general tomorrow.

kevin: thanks.

jun: will open the PR now.

olivia: starting runbook draft."
